prompt:
Redraw reference image 1 as one finished landscape illustration in our established hand-painted Japanese anime style. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and controls all subject, costume, composition, gesture, station setting, lighting and palette. Images 2, 3 and 4 are TECHNIQUE-ONLY references: image 2 controls structural hair/cloth facets and brush scale, image 3 the selective hand-drawn contours and chromatic grays, image 4 warm skin shapes, expressive transparent anime eye and warm/cool layered color. Borrow no identity, ears, accessories, pose, white background, signatures, watermarks or costume from images 2–4.

Preserve the high-angle view of Baita walking up toward the camera at the center of a busy railway station stairway, warm backlight, converging handrails, simplified commuters behind her and two soft foreground shoulder/head shapes. Preserve the existing framing and relative figure size. Preserve her oatmeal beige coat, muted dusty blue turtleneck knitted dress, brown tights and loafers, dark brown structured shoulder satchel with brass clasp; her left hand at screen-right grasps its strap, right hand at screen-left holds a small train ticket down beside her coat. Keep the light and palette of the target. No new props or magical effects.

IDENTITY LOCK: adult Baita, very long dark chocolate-brown wavy hair with abundant large loose curls, quiet gentle bookish expression and slight smile. Her heavy side-swept fringe completely covers the eye on the VIEWER'S LEFT. Only the eye on the VIEWER'S RIGHT is visible, a clear GREEN iris with defined eyelids and layered subtle highlights. Keep the two slender GOLD hair clips on that exposed-eye side. This single-eye-covered hairstyle is intentional and must remain. Do not reveal or draw an eye through the covering hair. No animal ears, horns, hats, glasses or altered hair color.

RENDERING CHANGE: repaint the entire image, including the background, with opaque layered color blocks, directional strokes, firm light-shadow boundaries and varied hand-drawn contours. Use substantial interlocking hair locks, curved elongated strokes alternating with short angular cuts; keep the dark brown curls clearly recognizable but replace evenly polished strand ribbons and repeated narrow highlights with chromatic midtone planes, colored shadows and a few broken highlight shapes. Hair has connected quiet areas and local structured detail, not uniform strand networks. Sculpt the coat with broad calm color fields, long fold planes and local short overpainting at collar/cuffs/tension points. Simplify the sweater's repetitive knit rendering into a few readable structural marks and painted folds. Maintain complete anatomy and silhouettes. Face and visible eye are selectively resolved, skin uses calm warm shapes with selected soft transitions, fringe shadow and coherent cast shadows, restrained blush. Warm and cool gray overpainting follows form. Lines vary in weight, color and continuity, with some buried under paint; crisp focal edges alternate with softer secondary edges. Render the station/crowd with economical coherent painterly planes and controlled light rather than photographic lens gloss. Keep skin softer, cloth matte, hardware with sparse distinct reflections. Richly painted but not uniformly fussy. Avoid flat vector fills, glossy airbrush plastic, all-over grain filters, random equal-sized triangle confetti, sketchy incomplete silhouettes. No text, signatures, watermark, logos, border or UI. Preserve landscape aspect ratio of the target.
user_decision: 2026-10-20: One-eye-covered side bangs accepted as Baita identity anchor; redraw station candidate in current project default style.

Oatmeal/blue/brown costume, ticket, strap gesture and warm crowd composition retained. Hair, coat and station repainted in directional layered planes; sweater still retains dense geometric knitting marks. Front shoe remains partly cropped. Assistant observation, awaiting user evaluation.
scope: Candidate only; no runtime replacement, tests, build or commit.
